text: PR #5486 (#5471, EXPORT DATABASE TYPE SQL) merged as v1-development, issue #5471 closed. Real 5-finding review round beforehand: 1 P1 security (CR/LF SQL-comment injection via the DBC catalog's own DATABASE name -- fixed with a control-char sanitizer), 3 P1 correctness (currency fields mismapped to DECIMAL derived from raw descriptor length/decimals instead of a fixed DECIMAL(19,4); datetime fields left as raw unconverted internal 'julian:X millis:Y' storage strings instead of real timestamp literals -- added a Julian-day-to-Gregorian conversion mirroring the runtime's own algorithm, duplicated since cf_vfp_assets can't depend on cf_xbase_runtime; blank numeric cells emitting invalid empty-string literals instead of NULL), 1 Copilot (O(rows*fields^2) inefficiency + unrecognized logical values defaulting FALSE instead of NULL). All fixed and verified locally including a hand-checked Julian-day conversion match. Also scoped the rest of #137's migration-pipeline umbrella to concrete leaf issues #5472-#5485 across its other 5 child lanes.
